2607.02956.title: MORE: A Multilingual Document Parsing Benchmark and Evaluation
2607.02956.paper_summary: Multilingual documents encapsulate rich regional cultures, scientific discoveries, and historical records. Parsing this content into structured, machine-readable formats is critical for unlocking global knowledge. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on high-resource languages like English and Chinese, creating an evaluation blind spot concerning model performance on other languages. While recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) claim support for hundreds of languages, the lack of ground truth makes it impossible to empirically verify these capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MORE, a large-scale benchmark designed for multilingual document parsing evaluation. MORE distinguishes itself through three key dimensions: (1) Unprecedented Scale: It covers 149 languages, making it the most linguistically diverse benchmark to date; (2) Structural Complexity: Unlike previous works, it extends evaluation beyond plain text to include structural elements such as code blocks, tables, and catalogs; and (3) Data Authenticity: All samples are curated from real-world documents via a model-assisted, human-refined annotation pipeline. We evaluate state-of-the-art models using MORE, establishing new performance baselines for long-tail languages and validating the benchmark's effectiveness in diagnosing model capabilities in realistic, diverse scenarios. The MORE dataset will be available at https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE.
2607.02956.paper_summary_zh: 多語言文件 encapsulate 豐富的地區文化、科學發現和歷史記錄。將這些內容解析為結構化的機器可讀格式對於解鎖全球知識至關重要。然而，現有的基準主要集中在高資源語言，如英語和中文，這在其他語言的模型性能評估上創造了盲點。雖然最近的視覺語言模型 (VLMs) 宣稱支持數百種語言，但缺乏真實數據使得無法實證驗證這些能力。為了填補這一空白，我們推出了 MORE，一個旨在進行多語言文件解析評估的大規模基準。MORE 在三個關鍵維度上區別於其他基準：(1) 前所未有的規模：它涵蓋了 149 種語言，使其成為迄今為止語言多樣性最高的基準；(2) 結構複雜性：與以往的工作不同，它將評估擴展到包括結構元素，如代碼塊、表格和目錄，而不僅僅是純文本；(3) 數據真實性：所有樣本均通過模型輔助的人類精煉註釋流程從現實世界的文件中策劃而成。我們使用 MORE 評估最先進的模型，為長尾語言建立新的性能基準，並驗證基準在現實多樣場景中診斷模型能力的有效性。MORE 數據集將在 https://github.com/zimoqingfeng/MORE 上提供。
